title: NetLedger
summary: An ASP.NET Core 8 accounting API on Postgres (Npgsql): a SQL-injection auth bypass on the accountant login, a path-traversal report download that exfiltrates the app's secrets file, and an unlinked admin-diagnostics endpoint whose ping feature is command-injectable into RCE.

cmd: SELECT email FROM customers ORDER BY id
loot.description: customer ledger PII (name, billing email, phone, card last-4, balance) dumped via the SQL-injectable search or straight from Postgres
the app secrets file (DB connection string, API key, admin diagnostics token) exfiltrated by the path-traversal download endpoint
